'''Corelli-Cola''' was a type of [[cola]] invented during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
{{Quote|I need the survey results of taste tests of my new beverage, Corelli-Cola. Could you check on whether it's ready?|Inventor of Corelli-Cola, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG" />}}
Corelli-Cola was a [[cola]] beverage that, according to a survey of taste testers, was not very palatable. One taste test survey taker claimed that the cola could possibly work as [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]] [[Oil/Legends|oil]].<ref name="SWG" />

==History==
{{Quote|Gaah! And I'd planned a big product rollout this month! Well, back to the lab.|The creator of Corelli-Cola, after seeing the survey results|<ref name="SWG" />}}
During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], an inventor sought to create a type of cola, a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] beverage named Corelli-Cola. The inventor planned a big a product rollout of the cola, but before doing so, the inventor required survey results of blind taste tests for the new beverage.<ref name="SWG" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] agreed to receive the taste test results from a survey taker in exchange for a [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] payout. The survey taker remarked that the cola might work as repulsorlift engine oil, implying that it was quite unsuitable for consumption. When the inventor of the cola received the [[Datacard/Legends|datadisc]] of the survey results from the spacer, the creator woefully remarked that they would have to return to the [[Laboratory/Legends|lab]] for further refinements.<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Corelli-Cola was first mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Early in the game's lifespan, dynamically spawned non-player characters offered a variety of simple [[W:c:swg:Quest|missions]]. In this case, NPCs could offer a delivery mission titled "Blind Taste Tests." The mission required the player to receive a [[W:c:swg:Datadisc|datadisc]] from an NPC, and deliver it back to their assigned [[W:c:swg:Waypoint|waypoint]] in exchange for a [[W:c:swg:Imperial Credit|credit]] reward.<ref name="SWG" />
